overloads.semanticRole: The SET BLOBS CACHE PRIORITY command sets a specific priority to the "blobs" data related to aTable in cache for all processes in the current session.

constraints: Only works in local mode (4D Server and 4D single-user); cannot be used in 4D remote mode.
Should be called in the On Startup or On Server Startup database method to affect the whole session.
Applies to BLOB, text, picture, and object data fields of aTable, and only when they are stored in the data file (not externally).
